items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: I was on some of his records, too. The Bells Are Ringing, Lily May... and then I stayed eight weeks with him in Nashville, Tennessee.

ctx.x: I picked up some of those records, I had a couple of those records.

Yeah, well, I was on some of his records, too. The Bells Are Ringing, Lily May, and you know, you know what I mean, all the records that sold, you know, all the records that sold. Yeah, and then I stayed eight weeks with him in Nashville, Tennessee. Oh. Stayed eight weeks.
